Initial release — quickly turn photos into a 1080p MP4 video using cloud GPUs.

- Converts JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC images up to 200MB into slideshow videos.
- Automatic token and session management, including free anonymous access.
- Supports transitions, background music, text overlays, and aspect ratio control.
- Key commands: upload, export, check credits/balance, track session state.
- Robust error handling (file type, size, credits, authentication).
- Typical video turnaround in 30-60 seconds, export in MP4 format.
